title: dotnet-crap baseline v1
description: Regression baseline written by --write-baseline and read by --baseline. Unknown fields are rejected.

threshold.description: The threshold in force when the baseline was written; it must match the scan's threshold.

entries.description: Callables that exceeded the threshold, ordered by file, line, then signature.

scope.description: Enclosing namespaces, types and callables, joined with '.'.

occurrence.description: Index among same-file callables with the same kind, scope and signature.

fingerprint.description: Hex SHA-256 over the callable's leaf tokens.

line.description: One-based starting line when written; informational.

coverage.description: Coverage fraction when written; null without evidence.
